CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Origin and Consequences of Sin? (1 mark)

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Origin and Consequences of Sin.
   C. Use Origin and Consequences of Sin to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Origin and Consequences of Sin with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   A. Apply the teaching of Teachings on Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

11. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)

   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

12. Which response best shows understanding of Abrahamic Covenant? (1 mark)

14. Honesty means: (1 mark)

   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

15. Which response best shows understanding of Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5? (1 mark)
